facts.fact: A Medias24 column by Sami El Moudni says Morocco has Law 09.08 on protection of individuals in personal data processing, adopted in 2009, and describes its article 11 safeguards on automated decisions.

MAR.note: Names Law 55.19 on administrative simplification but does not say it provides for public bodies sharing data.
Document states nothing this study asks for this country.
